blocks.name: L1_qcd_yang_mills
blocks.why: SU(3)_c field strength + gluon self-interaction. This is a working Yang–Mills piece. g_s is an input.

blocks.name: L2_electroweak_higgs
blocks.why: SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y + Higgs. After SSB, W/Z masses and the Weinberg rotation. g, g', v, λ are inputs.

blocks.name: L3_fermion_gauge
blocks.why: Quarks and leptons couple to W, Z, A. Three generations and CKM are copied in, not derived.

blocks.name: L4_yukawa
blocks.why: Higgs–fermion couplings write masses as m = y v / √2. The y's are inputs. Koide is not in this term.

blocks.name: L5_ghosts
blocks.why: Faddeev–Popov ghosts. Bookkeeping for the path integral. Not a physical force.

isomorphisms.name: SU2_iso_Spin3
isomorphisms.why: SU(2) ≅ Spin(3) ≅ Sp(1) as Lie groups. Does not output a coupling.

isomorphisms.name: U1_iso_SO2
isomorphisms.why: U(1) ≅ SO(2) ≅ S¹. Does not output α.

isomorphisms.name: weinberg_rotation
isomorphisms.why: (Z, A)^T = R(θ_W) (W³, B)^T. A real SO(2) on field space. θ_W is an input, not an output.

isomorphisms.name: goldstone_eaten
isomorphisms.why: Three Goldstones ≅ longitudinal W±, Z (equivalence theorem). Degrees of freedom, not a number.

isomorphisms.name: U3xU2xU1_is_cosmo_16
isomorphisms.why: Generator-count ≠ Cosmo 16 ≠ nature leftovers. A dimension count is P1, not F.

isomorphisms.name: gluon_cubic_is_NS
isomorphisms.why: f^{abc} A A ∂A looks like convection. Different PDE, different manifold, no map onto ω·Sω.

isomorphisms.name: yukawa_is_koide
isomorphisms.why: Yukawas are independent inputs. Koide is a 1981 mass-ratio, not a term in L4.

isomorphisms.name: harmonic_phenotype
isomorphisms.why: Calling L a harmonic phenotype does not write F and does not move Track B.

missing.name: gravity_G
missing.why: G_N is not a field in this Lagrangian.

missing.name: cosmological_constant
missing.why: Λ is not a term in this Lagrangian.

missing.name: neutrino_masses
missing.why: Minimal poster SM has none. Data need them or a bound.

missing.name: theta_qcd
missing.why: Usually omitted on the poster. Strong-CP leftover.

realized_equation.name: Einstein_plus_T_SM
realized_equation.action: S = S_EH[g] + ∫ √−g L_SM(g, ψ, A, H)
realized_equation.why: This is the equation with an equals sign that actually uses L_SM. T_μν is the Hilbert / Noether stress from blocks 1–4. The couple works (equivalence). It does not output g_s, θ_W, G, or Λ.
